description: Split large text into smaller semantic chunks for LLM context optimization or vector databases (RAG).

chunkOverlap.description: The number of overlapping characters between consecutive chunks. Defaults to 200.

chunkSize.description: The maximum character size of each chunk. Defaults to 1000.

strategy.description: The chunking strategy: 'character', 'word', 'sentence', or 'paragraph'. Defaults to 'paragraph'.

name: ai_text_chunker
